units.source_text: 也许走得太急了，我们在回家的路上几乎没有说话。

en.t: Perhaps because we had walked too quickly, we hardly spoke on the way home.

units.source_text: 回到家里吃饭的时候，夫人问我们怎么回来晚了。

en.t: When we got home and were eating, the lady of the house asked why we had come back so late.

units.source_text: 我说K叫我一起去了上野。

en.t: I said that K had asked me to go with him to Ueno.

units.source_text: ‘这大冷的天，还去上野？’夫人显得非常惊讶。

en.t: “To Ueno, in weather as cold as this?” the lady of the house said, looking very surprised.

units.source_text: 小姐想知道我们为什么去上野，我只是回答，也没什么，就是去散散步。

en.t: The young lady wanted to know why we had gone to Ueno, but I only answered that it was nothing, just a walk.

units.source_text: 一向寡言少语的K，比平时更沉默了。

en.t: K, who was always a man of few words, was even more silent than usual.

units.source_text: 夫人跟他说话，小姐冲他笑，他都带答不理的。

en.t: Whether the lady of the house spoke to him or the young lady smiled at him, he barely responded.

units.source_text: 他三口两口吃完了饭，不等我吃完，就先回自己房间去了。

en.t: He quickly finished his meal in a few mouthfuls and went back to his room before I had finished eating.
